sequences.goal: Establish the evening dispatch baseline, discover the allergy-label timestamp mismatch, and clarify that volunteers are not an unlimited overflow labor pool.
sequences.pressure: Packaging is already behind and the first set of delivery crates is being assembled.
sequences.decision_turn: C03 quarantines the suspect allergy meal bundles for trace-back; C06 states that volunteer work cannot silently expand into contracted loading work.
sequences.exit_state: Allergy bundles are isolated; volunteer scope remains unresolved but explicitly owned by C06; dispatch schedule loses easy slack.

sequences.goal: Expose the cooling discrepancy and separate batch-level schedule pressure from container-level food-safety evidence.
sequences.pressure: Some containers are scheduled for the earliest route while cooling readings disagree.
sequences.decision_turn: C02 defines suspect-container hold, repeat-measure interval, and release/discard conditions without requiring C01 approval.
sequences.exit_state: Normal containers remain eligible; suspect containers are isolated with a timed recheck; C01 must plan around uncertainty rather than erase it.

sequences.goal: Turn C04's tacit porridge-consistency skill into transferable observation and failure signals before the incoming cook takes over.
sequences.pressure: C04 cannot stay through the entire morning shift and the written recipe alone will not predict hold-thickening.
sequences.decision_turn: C04 chooses to teach observable time/texture checkpoints and non-recoverable failure boundaries instead of doing the batch herself.
sequences.exit_state: A provisional transferable method exists but must survive later verification under actual hold time.

sequences.goal: Resolve immediate volunteer-task scope while the allergy trace-back consumes paid staff attention.
sequences.pressure: Packaging delay tempts the team to use volunteers for heavy loading and unrestricted repacking.
sequences.decision_turn: C06 limits volunteers to low-risk label cross-check and cart organization with a defined stop time; heavy loading stays with paid staff.
sequences.exit_state: Labor boundary is operationally clear; staff capacity is tighter; allergy trace-back gains bounded assistance without transferring responsibility.

sequences.goal: Convert the externally advanced route window into a split-dispatch plan instead of pushing all unresolved food onto the first vehicle.
sequences.pressure: Road construction creates a 06:40 access cutoff for one service zone.
sequences.decision_turn: C05 creates first-wave and follow-up manifests based on verified safety/allergy status and owns seal times for each wave.
sequences.exit_state: The operation now has two delivery waves; unresolved containers/bundles stay off the first list; later work must meet explicit handoff points.

sequences.goal: Re-enter cooling and allergy problems under the new split-dispatch structure and prevent schedule logic from mutating safety/identity decisions.
sequences.pressure: The first-wave list has limited capacity and every held item changes vehicle balance and recipient counts.
sequences.decision_turn: C02 and C03 independently update release/hold states; C05 revises manifests without overriding either decision.
sequences.exit_state: First-wave contents become more stable but smaller; follow-up wave inherits named unresolved items rather than a vague remainder.

sequences.goal: Verify the transferred porridge method and complete volunteer shutdown without letting remaining work pull volunteers back in.
sequences.pressure: The replacement cook must reproduce the method while packaging and cleaning continue.
sequences.decision_turn: C04 observes the replacement cook apply the checkpoints and only intervenes at a predefined failure signal; C06 closes volunteer participation at the declared stop time.
sequences.exit_state: Craft transfer passes a first repeatability check; volunteer labor ends; remaining workload is visibly staff-owned.

sequences.goal: Introduce the advanced fire-door/egress test and integrate it with cart staging, first-wave sealing, and wash-return traffic.
sequences.pressure: The same corridor is needed for dispatch carts, empty insulated boxes, washing returns and the 06:55 egress test.
sequences.decision_turn: C01 collects each owner's non-movable time/space constraints and reserves the egress corridor rather than centralizing all carts in one temporary pile.
sequences.exit_state: A time-phased spatial plan exists; each team retains its task ownership; first-wave staging is moved to a non-egress zone.

sequences.goal: Convert overnight checks into the first sealed dispatch while leaving unresolved items correctly assigned to the follow-up wave.
sequences.pressure: Release decisions, final allergy trace-back, porridge hold behavior and vehicle cutoff converge.
sequences.decision_turn: C02 releases/discards based on frozen conditions; C03 finalizes only traceable allergy meals; C05 seals the first-wave manifest and excludes unresolved items; C04 completes handoff of the porridge method.
sequences.exit_state: First vehicle is legally and semantically ready to depart; remaining items have explicit owners and conditions, not generic delay status.

sequences.goal: Execute first departure, fire-door test, follow-up preparation, and distribute future-thread ownership without recentering C01.
sequences.pressure: Departure, egress test and morning handoff occur within the same hour.
sequences.decision_turn: C01 coordinates only shared-space collisions; C05 owns follow-up transport; C06 owns labor/recipient-handoff rule follow-up; C03 owns allergy traceability improvement; C02 hands cooling-rule evidence to C01 for operating procedure; C04's transfer evidence passes to C03 for documentation.
sequences.exit_state: Immediate crisis closes with distributed owners preserved and concrete future obligations seeded across the ensemble.

next_legal_action: Create and seal a shared 50-scene semantic plan with location/time, goal, obstacle, turn, exit state and speaking-character set only; no screenplay prose or expression cue.
